ZPOOL-DETACH(8)              System Manager's Manual            ZPOOL-DETACH(8)

NAME
       zpool-detach — detach device from ZFS mirror

SYNOPSIS
       zpool detach pool device

DESCRIPTION
       Detaches device from a mirror.  The operation is refused if there are no
       other valid replicas of the data.  If device may be re-added to the pool
       later on then consider the zpool offline command instead.

SEE ALSO
       zpool-attach(8), zpool-labelclear(8), zpool-offline(8), zpool-remove(8),
       zpool-replace(8), zpool-split(8)

OpenZFS                          August 9, 2019                 ZPOOL-DETACH(8)
